description.tr: Bursa şehir merkezinden (Heykel) başlayıp Uludağ Milli Parkı içinden, orman kuşağı ve Kirazlıyayla üzerinden Oteller Bölgesi'ne tırmanan virajlı dağ yolu. Yükseldikçe Bursa ovası ve şehir manzarası açılır.
description.en: A winding mountain road that climbs from Bursa city centre (Heykel) through Uludağ National Park, the forest belt and Kirazlıyayla up to the Hotels Area. Views over the Bursa plain and the city open up as you climb.

description.en: From Antalya city centre west into the Taurus foothills and up to the Saklıkent ski centre on Mount Bakırlı. Views of the Gulf of Antalya and the Beydağları range along the climb; sea level to ski resort in a single ride.

description.en: From Maçka south along the old alignment of the historic Trabzon–Erzurum (Trabzon–Gümüşhane) road, over the Zigana Pass and down to Torul. It crosses the pass itself instead of the tunnel; dense forest, highland pastures and seas of fog.

description.en: From Kemaliye (Eğin) town down to the Kemaliye Bridge over the Euphrates, then along the Kemaliyeliler Stone Road through tunnels cut into the rock of the Dark Canyon. Narrow single-lane sections with the Euphrates flowing far below.

description.tr: Kâhta'dan D360 ile Narince'ye, oradan Gerger–Narince yolu (02-05) ve 02-06 ile Karadut üzerinden Nemrut Dağı Milli Parkı'na tırmanan klasik güney yaklaşımı. Ziyaretçi merkezinin (güney girişi) önünden geçip zirvedeki Kommagene Kralı I. Antiochos tümülüsünün güneybatısındaki Nemrut Otoparkı'nda biter. Son kesim dik ve virajlı; gün doğumu ve gün batımı manzaralarıyla ünlü. Cendere Köprüsü ve Eski Kâhta (Arsameia) bu güzergâhın üzerinde değildir.
description.en: The classic southern approach: from Kâhta along the D360 to Narince, then via the Gerger–Narince road (02-05) and the 02-06 through Karadut up into Mount Nemrut National Park. It passes the visitor centre (south entrance) and ends at the Nemrut car park south-west of the summit tumulus of King Antiochus I of Commagene. The final section is steep and twisty; famous for sunrise and sunset views. Cendere Bridge and Eski Kâhta (Arsameia) are not on this route.

bestSeason.en: May–October (road may be closed by snow in winter)

name.el: Δρόμος του Πηλίου: Βόλος – Χάνια – Ζαγορά
name.en: Pelion Mountain Road: Volos – Hania – Zagora

description.el: Ορεινή διαδρομή από το κέντρο του Βόλου που ανεβαίνει με στροφές από την Ανακασιά και την Πορταριά (ΕΟ34α) στο διάσελο των Χανίων (περίπου 1.190 μ.) και κατεβαίνει μέσα από δάση οξιάς και καστανιάς στη Ζαγορά, στην πλευρά του Αιγαίου. Θέα στον Παγασητικό κόλπο και στον Βόλο στην ανάβαση και στο Αιγαίο στην κατάβαση.
description.en: A mountain road from central Volos that climbs in bends through Anakasia and Portaria (EO34a) to the Hania pass (about 1,190 m), then descends through beech and chestnut forest to Zagora on the Aegean side. Views over the Pagasetic Gulf and Volos on the climb and over the Aegean on the descent.

bestSeason.el: Απρίλιος–Οκτώβριος (τον χειμώνα πιθανό χιόνι και πάγος στο διάσελο των Χανίων)
bestSeason.en: April–October (snow and ice possible at the Hania pass in winter)

verification.notes: 2026-11-07 kontrolü (rota-uzmani): çizginin 48 noktasının tümü yola oturuyor (OSRM nearest en fazla 1 m); başlangıç Γρηγορίου Λαμπράκη (ΕΟ34) caddesinin doğuya giden şeridinde OSM node 287465983 (way 476340903, oneway, ışıklı yaya geçidi; Βόλος place=city node 135531710'un 35 m güneyi), bitiş OSM yer düğümü (Ζαγορά place=town node 1827940526, Nominatim 29 m). Seçim gerekçesi: Pelion dağ yolu Volos–Portaria–Hania–Zagora, motorcuların bilinen rotası (Best Biking Roads, 'Mt Pelion: Volos - Zagora - Mouresi', 2012 sürücü yorumu: 'the best route for motorcycling in Magnesia (Volos)', Portaria–Hania arası geniş virajlar); Hania (Χάνια) Volos–Zagora il yolu üzerinde, 1.190 m, Volos'a 26 km (el.wikipedia 'Χάνια Μαγνησίας', 2026-11-07 erişim). Geometri: OpenStreetMap verisi üzerinde OSRM (router.project-osrm.org, sürüş profili, overview=full) ile 2026-11-07 tarihinde alındı (scripts/add_greece_route.py), koordinatlar 5 ondalığa yuvarlandı. Gidip-dönme yok. 2026-11-08 düzeltmesi (rota-uzmani): başlangıç önceden Βόλος yer düğümüydü; OSRM onu caddenin batıya giden şeridine yapıştırıyor, rota 150 m batıdaki dönel kavşakta (22,93845 / 39,36232) tam dönüş yapıp doğuya giden şeritten geri geliyordu (eski km 0–0,40). Yüzey: OSM'de güzergâhın etiketli tüm yolları surface=asphalt (ΕΟ34, ΕΟ34α, Ζαγορά - Πουρί); toprak/taşlı etiket yok. Doğrulanmalı: Hania rakımı (kaynakta 1.190 m, OSM düğümünde ele yok), kışın kar/buz ve olası kapanmalar, bestSeason (Nisan–Ekim proje önerisi), zorluk (moderate, proje değerlendirmesi), yol yüzeyinin güncel durumu; OSRM grafiği OSM'nin en yeni düzenlemelerinden (ör. Anakasia'daki ΕΟ34α yeniden çizimi) eski olabilir, sahada teyit edilmeli. Volos şehir içi kesim (km 0–~5,4) kavşak ve dönüşler içerir.

name.es: Sierra de Grazalema: El Bosque – Puerto de las Palomas – Zahara de la Sierra
name.en: Sierra de Grazalema: El Bosque – Puerto de las Palomas – Zahara de la Sierra

description.es: Carretera de montaña por el Parque Natural Sierra de Grazalema. Desde El Bosque, la A-372 sube con curvas amplias entre pinares y encinas hasta el Puerto del Boyar (unos 1.100 m), con vistas al valle y a la campiña de Cádiz. Cerca de Grazalema se toma la CA-9104, estrecha y muy revirada, que pasa por el Puerto de las Palomas (unos 1.190 m) y baja en horquillas hacia Zahara de la Sierra, con vistas al embalse de Zahara-El Gastor.
description.en: A mountain road through the Sierra de Grazalema Natural Park. From El Bosque the A-372 climbs in wide bends through pine and holm-oak woods to the Puerto del Boyar (about 1,100 m), with views over the valley and the Cádiz countryside. Near Grazalema the route takes the narrow, very winding CA-9104 over the Puerto de las Palomas (about 1,190 m) and descends in hairpins to Zahara de la Sierra, with views over the Zahara-El Gastor reservoir.

bestSeason.es: Marzo–junio y septiembre–noviembre (en invierno puede haber hielo o cierres puntuales en los puertos; en verano, mucho calor)
bestSeason.en: March–June and September–November (ice or occasional closures on the passes in winter; very hot in summer)

name.pt: Serra do Rio do Rastro: Lauro Müller – Bom Jardim da Serra (SC-390)
name.en: Serra do Rio do Rastro: Lauro Müller – Bom Jardim da Serra (SC-390)

description.pt: Estrada de serra pela SC-390, no sul de Santa Catarina. De Lauro Müller, a rodovia segue pelo vale e sobe a escarpa da Serra Geral em dezenas de curvas fechadas, num trecho pavimentado em concreto, até o mirante no alto da serra (cerca de 1.400 m), com vista para as curvas da estrada e, em dias claros, até o litoral. Depois continua pelo planalto, entre campos de altitude, até Bom Jardim da Serra.
description.en: A mountain road on the SC-390 in southern Santa Catarina. From Lauro Müller the highway follows the valley and climbs the Serra Geral escarpment in dozens of tight bends, on a concrete-paved section, to the viewpoint at the top of the range (about 1,400 m), overlooking the road's curves and, on clear days, the coast. It then continues across the highland grasslands to Bom Jardim da Serra.

bestSeason.pt: Março–maio e setembro–novembro (no inverno, geada, gelo e às vezes neve no alto da serra; neblina pode fechar a estrada em qualquer época)
bestSeason.en: March–May and September–November (frost, ice and occasionally snow at the top in winter; fog can close the road at any time of year)
